card.name: Low blood pressure management wording
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas in hypotension passages, mostly just before 'supine' or fainting-type symptoms. Fires where the text says to place the patient supine or lists dizziness, lightheadedness and fainting.

modes.label: Placing patient supine
modes.description: Small words after 'placed' or 'supine' in instructions for treating hypotension.
modes.example: The patient should be placed supine<< with>> the legs elevated.

modes.label: Symptom list commas
modes.description: Commas between dizziness, lightheadedness and fainting in symptomatic hypotension.

modes.label: Linking words before hypotension or syncope
modes.description: Words like 'where' or 'that' leading into syncope or hypotension-causing agents.
modes.example: should be cautioned to avoid situations<< where>> syncope could result in an injury
